mechanism: Isoniazid may inhibit the metabolism of captopril and increase ACE inhibitor levels, while both drugs can independently affect renal function and blood pressure; additionally, isoniazid-induced peripheral neuropathy risk may be exacerbated by captopril's effects on fluid/electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function periodically; assess for signs of captopril toxicity (persistent cough, dizziness, hyperkalemia); manage isoniazid-associated neuropathy with pyridoxine supplementation.
